title: FEMASYS INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-29
summary: Femasys Inc., a Nasdaq-listed medical device company, filed an 8-K reporting results from a Special Meeting of Stockholders held on April 29, 2026. Stockholders approved a reverse stock split at a ratio of 1-for-2 to 1-for-25 at the board's discretion, and approved issuance of shares below Nasdaq minimum price to satisfy anti-dilution provisions on convertible notes and warrants.
key_points: Reverse stock split approved at ratio range of 1-for-2 to 1-for-25, to be implemented at board's discretion prior to May 1, 2027
Proposal One (reverse split) passed with 18,914,440 votes for, 5,187,820 against, 1 abstention
Proposal Two (share issuance for anti-dilution) passed with 7,483,951 votes for, 1,693,085 against, 14,925,225 broker non-votes
Approximately 39.91% of outstanding shares (24,102,261 shares) were present or represented at the meeting
Company is an emerging growth company as defined by Rule 405 of the Securities Act
Femasys trades under symbol FEMY on Nasdaq Capital Market
